summary: More community.postgresql deprecations: db/database aliases in schema, script, sequence, set, slot, subscription, table, tablespace and user_obj_stat_info modules; rename options in favor of postgresql_query; and postgresql_set in favor of postgresql_alter_system.
questions: How do I rename a table with community.postgresql 5?

answer_card.title: postgresql_set and rename options deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
- `postgresql_set` is deprecated and removed in 5.0.0; use **`community.postgresql.postgresql_alter_system`**.
- `postgresql_sequence` `rename_to`, `postgresql_table` `rename` and `postgresql_tablespace` `rename_to` are deprecated; use **`postgresql_query`**.
- `db`/`database` aliases are deprecated in `postgresql_schema`, `postgresql_script`, `postgresql_sequence`, `postgresql_set`, `postgresql_slot`, `postgresql_subscription`, `postgresql_table`, `postgresql_tablespace` and `postgresql_user_obj_stat_info`; use `login_db`.
